result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a clear text overlap: the delivery-time line and the delivery-fee line are drawn on top of each other, making both unreadable. Carousel edge clipping and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ("25–35 min") and the delivery fee text ("€0 delivery") overlap in the same position below the restaurant name, so both are garbled and unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and fee on separate lines or in separate flex items with proper spacing, and make sure the metadata row wraps or truncates instead of overlapping when text is long.
